name: Płaczliwa Sprawa
source: Chris is a shy high school student who's being bullied because his schoolmates think that he looks and acts like a girl. They often call him "Chrissy". One day, Chris finds a letter from someone, saying that they can help him...
translation: 克里斯是一名腼腆的高中生。因为外表与举止都像女孩，他一直遭同学欺凌，还常被叫作“克里茜”。一天，克里斯发现一封神秘来信，寄信人声称能帮助他……
